Would you like to work at Schiphol Airport and help prepare and assemble meals while packing catering trolleys for international airlines? Gate Gourmet Schiphol is looking for enthusiastic Production Catering Employees. Previous experience is not required, as you will receive training and guidance from experienced colleagues.

What are you going to do?
At Gate Gourmet Schiphol, you can work in one of three different departments. Together with your team, you will ensure that aircraft are fully supplied with meals and other onboard products. The three departments are Pick & Pack, Wash & Pack, and Make & Pack.

Pick & Pack

- Assemble airline trolleys with meals, snacks, and retail products.
- Monitor stock levels and work according to strict quality and safety procedures.
- Ensure accurate preparation of catering supplies for departing flights.

Wash & Pack

- Clean airline trolleys and catering equipment.
- Sort and reuse suitable materials.
- Prepare equipment for upcoming flights.

Make & Pack

- Prepare and assemble passenger meals.
- Collect and process ingredients according to recipes.
- Work in compliance with HACCP and hygiene regulations.
- Package and inspect finished products to ensure quality standards are met.

What do we offer?
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
- You are available to work full-time (40 hours per week).
- You are able to obtain a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and an Aviation Security Clearance (VGB).
- You have been continuously residing in the Netherlands for the past 8 years.
- You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
- You enjoy working in a structured production environment.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience in production, the food industry, logistics, or airline catering.
- Knowledge of HACCP procedures.
- Affinity with food production and logistics processes.

Where will you work?

Looking for a full-time job where you work with your hands and feel welcome? As a production worker at Luiten, a family-run meat processing company in Zoetermeer, you work in a friendly team and make good products together. You do not work alone. You are part of the team.  

As a production worker, you will work on the production floor preparing high-quality meat products. Your tasks: 

- Seasoning, mixing, and vacuum-packing meat products 
- Working with veal and pork 
- Keeping the workplace clean and safe 

No experience? No problem! We teach you everything step by step.    

Working hours: 

- Start time between 06:00 and 09:00 AM 
- Workdays are usually around 8 hours 
- Because we work with fresh products, flexibility is important 

You like working with your hands and making good products. As a production worker at Luiten, your work really matters.
This job as a production worker is for you if: 

- You like working with your hands 
- You speak English or Dutch, so you can communicate well with your colleagues and follow work instructions 
- You are available full-time

Looking for a warehouse job with a fast hiring process and great pay? Whether you prefer working day shifts or a 3-shift rotation, this is your chance to join a leading logistics environment and start quickly. Earn up to €17.00 gross per hour, receive a travel allowance, and build up a pension while developing your logistics skills. Ready to get started? Apply today!

Manpower is looking for a Warehouse Assistant for a company in Hengelo.

As a Warehouse Assistant, you will be responsible for:

    - Picking and preparing orders for shipment
    
- Sorting products and outgoing shipments
    
- Performing quality inspections
    
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
    
- Operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
    
- Supporting general warehouse activities

What's in it for you?

    - Gross salary between €15.00 and €17.00 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Pension accrual
    
- Free development opportunities through Manpower Academy (more than 200 online courses)
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Opportunity to obtain a forklift certificate
    
- Choice between day shifts and a 3-shift rotation
    
- Opportunity to work for leading international logistics companies
    
- Fast and straightforward recruitment process
    
- Guidance and support from Manpower
    
- Part-time or full-time position of 24 to 40 hours per week

    - Availability of at least 24 hours per week
    
- Motivated and reliable attitude
    
- Ability to perform physical warehouse work
    
- Basic communication skills in English and/or Dutch
    
- Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not required
    
- Flexibility to work day shifts or a 3-shift rotation
    
- Accurate and hands-on approach to work

Ready to start working quickly in a logistics role with excellent earning potential and growth opportunities? Apply today and discover which warehouse opportunity in Hengelo is the perfect fit for you!

Do you enjoy staying active and working in a logistics environment where no two days are the same?

DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for a Logistics Employee – Day Shift for the Schneider Electric department. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.

Your responsibilities will include order picking, packing, loading and unloading goods, checking and sorting products, processing incoming shipments, and storing goods in the correct warehouse locations.

You will be part of a dynamic and international working environment with a wide variety of tasks. DHL offers thorough onboarding, excellent growth opportunities, and regularly organizes fun extras such as staff parties, food trucks, and team events.

- Good command of the English language
- Experience in logistics
- Ability to work with computer systems and Microsoft Excel
- Flexible and motivated attitude
- Own transportation
- EPT, forklift and/or reach truck certificates are an advantage

You don't start until 15:00, so you can sleep in, work out or study in the morning. On top of that, you earn a lot extra in the evening: from 20:00 onwards you get a 25% surcharge on top of your great gross hourly wage of € 16.04. A perfect opportunity to work full-time in logistics and make great money!

- Gross hourly wage of € 16.04.
- 25% evening surcharge after 20:00!
- Perfect afternoon and evening shifts.
- Working in a fun and close-knit team.
- Career growth at the successful Plieger.
- Fresh meals in the company restaurant

You are full of energy in the afternoon and evening. Physically demanding work is no problem for you, as you are in excellent health. Working with an EPT is (preferably) known to you.

- You are available full-time (15:00 - 00:00).
- You already have some logistics experience.
- You speak Dutch or English well.

What will you do
When the rest of the Netherlands slowly heads home, you start your workday fresh at Plieger. You collect orders, move goods with the EPT and ensure everything is ready for transport. Because you work in the afternoon and evening shift, the atmosphere is often slightly different: informal, with music in the background, but with a high work pace. Around midnight your shift is over and you go home highly satisfied.

Where will you work
Plieger in Zaltbommel is a leading wholesaler with an ultra-modern distribution center. We are known for our down-to-earth mentality. No unnecessary rules, just putting our shoulders to the wheel together. Because Plieger continues to grow rapidly, we love to invest in you. There are plenty of opportunities to learn new skills!

The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
- A clear growth path to Senior Data Center Engineer

As an experienced orbital welder, you play a key role in developing and producing prototypes and initial production runs. You work closely with engineers to evaluate new designs, determine the correct welding method, and apply it directly in the cleanroom production area. Your craftsmanship sets the standard for the rest of the production process. Thanks to your technical insight, designs are elevated to a higher level even before they reach the production line.

This role isn’t just about welding. It’s an opportunity to work daily with the latest technologies such as welding robots, cobots, lasers, and 3D printers. You bring knowledge and experience as an orbital welder perhaps also as a TIG welder or fabrication technician and you know better than anyone how to read technical drawings and translate them into top-quality work. Your structured working style, digital skills, and eagerness to learn make a real difference in a production environment where innovation is the standard.

You’ll join a team full of expertise, but also one that gives you the space to grow. There’s plenty of attention given to your development, initiative is appreciated, and your contribution to the final product is visible, tangible, and measurable. You’re not just creating metal connections here, you’re building solutions that make a global impact.

- You have demonstrable work experience at a comparable level
- You have experience with orbital welding
- You speak fluent English or Dutch

Are you interested in working with IT hardware and enjoy a practical role in a production environment? Do you like working with technology, paying attention to details, and being part of a team? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!

A growing company in Eindhoven is looking for a Production IT Employee. In this role, you will support the refurbishment process and help ensure that IT equipment is processed correctly and meets quality standards.

Your tasks include receiving and checking incoming hardware, testing devices, installing software, securely removing data, and keeping accurate records. You will also remove components from server racks and register them in the ERP system.

This role requires focus, precision, and the ability to perform repetitive tasks. You will work in a hands-on environment and be on your feet for most of the day.

- Basic English for communication with colleagues

- Accurate and able to follow basic logistics processes
